definitions.explanation: A self-service store selling food and household items. Short for スーパーマーケット.

examples.japanese: スーパーで{野菜|やさい}を{買|か}いました。
examples.english: I bought vegetables at the supermarket.

examples.japanese: このスーパーは{夜|よる}10{時|じ}まで{開|あ}いています。
examples.english: This supermarket is open until 10 PM.

examples.japanese: スーパーは{駅|えき}の{隣|となり}にあります。
examples.english: The supermarket is next to the station.

examples.japanese: スーパーの{特売日|とくばいび}には{早|はや}く{行|い}かないと{人|ひと}が{多|おお}いです。
examples.english: You have to go early on supermarket sale days because there are many people.

examples.japanese: {閉店|へいてん}{前|まえ}のスーパーでお{弁当|べんとう}が{安|やす}くなります。
examples.english: Bento boxes get cheaper at the supermarket before closing time.

notes:
スーパー is the common abbreviation of スーパーマーケット (supermarket). The full form is rarely used in conversation.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japanese supermarkets often discount prepared foods ({弁当|べんとう}, {惣菜|そうざい}) in the evening before closing, typically marked with {割引|わりびき} stickers showing 20-50% off.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- スーパーに{行|い}く: to go to the supermarket
- スーパーで{買|か}い{物|もの}をする: to shop at the supermarket
- {駅前|えきまえ}のスーパー: the supermarket near the station
- スーパーの{特売|とくばい}: supermarket sale

RELATED WORDS:
- コンビニ: convenience store
- デパート: department store
- {商店街|しょうてんがい}: shopping street
- {八百屋|やおや}: greengrocer
